title: Visualize supplier purchase exposure count groups
description: A purchasing user views a page-only count distribution in the existing dynamic supplier exposure designer. Development only. Reuse ERP-148 authorized bounded preview over ERP-031; keep all grouping to the current page, recheck current-user purchase-order menu and use existing HTTP operation audit. Preserve unknown settlement/receipt evidence, distinct currencies and ambiguous/unavailable links; never infer an accounts-payable balance or payment authority. Invalid modes and missing permission fail closed. No arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secrets/.env change or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Designer offers only ERP-152 grouping keys and sends selected key with the existing authorized page request.
Chart renders safe labeled counts by supplier, currency, link state or receipt state, including unknown classes, empty pages and pagination changes.
Node tests cover group selection, chart text, unknown and empty groups, permission/network errors and safe rendering; document page-only semantics.
